description: This Java class configures a batch job for transferring fee charges for loans within the Fineract platform. It defines beans for the job, its step, and the tasklet, wiring necessary services.

classes.name: TransferFeeChargeForLoansConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up the batch job to transfer fee charges for loans.

methods.name: transferFeeChargeForLoansStep
methods.description: Defines the batch step for transferring fee charges, using a tasklet.

methods.name: transferFeeChargeForLoansJob
methods.description: Defines the batch job that includes the step and a run ID incrementer.

methods.name: transferFeeChargeForLoansTasklet
methods.description: Creates the tasklet responsible for executing the fee transfer logic.
